items.title: Diet-microbiome interactions enhance cancer immunotherapy in obesity.
items.one_liner: In a recent issue of Nature, Desharnais and colleagues show that diet-dependent remodeling of the gut microbiome promotes anti-tumor immunity and may explain the enhanced efficacy of immune checkpoint blockade observed in obesity. Their study identifies dietary intervention as a promising strategy to optimize the host for cancer immunotherapy.
